cases.question: Which classes are kinds of Organization?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?c rdfs:subClassOf a:Organization . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?c), '#') AS ?v) }

cases.question: Which properties can a Supplier have?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?p rdfs:domain a:Supplier . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?p), '#') AS ?v) }

cases.question: Which classes are identified by documentId?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?c owl:hasKey/rdf:rest*/rdf:first a:documentId . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?c), '#') AS ?v) }

cases.question: Which suppliers have an audit with a major nonconformity that is still open?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?n a a:Nonconformity ; a:severity 'major' ; a:identifiedIn ?au . ?au a:audits ?s . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?n a:closedAt ?c } ?s a:supplierId ?v }

cases.question: Which quality documents are current, meaning no other document supersedes them?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?d a/rdfs:subClassOf* a:QualityDocument ; a:documentId ?v . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?x a:supersedes ?d } }

cases.question: Which client organisations are escalated to for nonconformities found at conditionally approved suppliers?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?n a:escalatesTo ?c ; a:identifiedIn ?au . ?au a:audits ?s . ?s a:classification 'conditional' . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?c), '#') AS ?v) }

cases.question: Which audits have no recorded auditor?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?au a a:Audit . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?au a:auditorId ?x } BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?au), '#') AS ?v) }

cases.question: How many nonconformities exist per severity?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { { SELECT ?sev (COUNT(?n) AS ?k) WHERE { ?n a a:Nonconformity ; a:severity ?sev } GROUP BY ?sev } BIND(CONCAT(?sev, '=', STR(?k)) AS ?v) }

cases.question: Which classes are kinds of Asset?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?c rdfs:subClassOf e:Asset . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?c), '#') AS ?v) }

cases.question: Which relations point at an Asset?
cases.sparql: SELECT ?v WHERE { ?p rdfs:range e:Asset . BIND(STRAFTER(STR(?p), '#') AS ?v) }
